system.description:
You have stolen information from the Hidden Leaf elite on their extreme training regimen and how they and their ability to utilize fire release techniques to guarantee success in battle.

Genwa Jutsu you cast that deal damage, gains a +1 bonus to the damage they deal equal to the number of dice they roll, up to a maximum of +10.

Once per turn, when you cast a Jutsu, one allied creature within 30 feet of you gains a d4 bonus to their next saving throw or check. A creature cannot benefit from this effect more than once every minute. This increases to a d6 at 11th level.

Jutsu you cast with the Sensory keyword that you benefit from gain the following effect; For the duration, you become invisible to Camera’s, sensors and electronic detection devices.
